name: 993 interior door opener lever, AlSi10Mg bionic, gyroid core (PicoGK)
material_candidate: AlSi10Mg LPBF (screening; grade of the commercial product unknown)
picogk_enhancement: Gyroid core: the published PicoGK body (bionic_topology) keeps its outer form; a 0.8 mm skin encloses a sheet gyroid (3.6 mm cell, 0.4 mm wall) wherever the body holds three cells, thinner zones and functional features stay solid, drain ports run to the nearest outer surface and any pocket they miss is filled solid. Core settings are assumptions for the lpbf metal class; nothing here is printed, depowdered or tested.

cell_mm.note: gyroid period; at least 9 walls so the channels stay open to the drains

wall_mm.note: gyroid sheet thickness; class minimum 0.4 mm, at least 2.5 voxels

skin_mm.note: outer skin; class minimum 0.8 mm, at least 3 voxels

min_cells.note: owner rule 2026-10-22: core only where three cells fit, else solid

drain_d_mm.note: powder/resin drain diameter; class minimum 2.0 mm

max_drains.note: lowest and highest core points, then farthest-point spread

open_interfaces: pivot pin diameter and length (lever slides off the pin downward - Rennlist)
plastic ball-joint stud size and position
mounting faces and stops of the OEM lever
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
